description: Protection Paladin-style tank - two parallel builder/spender pairs (Starburst/Starsweep for AoE, Starsunder/Lunar Lance for single target), with every block/parry/dodge feeding the kit.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc (real playstyle/rotation/ability names) + confirmed screenshot numbers where available (Command, Eclipse of Fury, Lunar Authority, Celestial Aegis confirmed via screenshot). Real mechanic per handoff: blocking seeds Scattered Stars (Nebula), avoiding attacks calls unavoidable Moonflares, parrying refunds Energy and hits back - tanking well IS dealing damage.

nodes.name: Moon Guard
nodes.description: Grants Intellect equal to your Strength.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 10 Passive. Grants Intellect equal to Strength.'

nodes.name: Virtue
nodes.description: Increases Attack Power scaling from Agility by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Starburst Invigoration
nodes.description: Increases Energy regeneration by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Endless Sky
nodes.description: Increases Stamina and maximum Mana by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Crystal Shield
nodes.description: Increases Stamina and spell damage scaling from Attack Power by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 30 Passive. Boosts Stamina + spell damage from AP.'

nodes.name: Starlord's Mandate
nodes.description: Increases Celestial Strike damage and reduces its Energy cost by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Starburst
nodes.description: Learn Starburst, smashing up to 8 enemies for Arcane damage that scales with block value and maximum mana, reducing their attack speed. Applies 1 Scattered Star per hit.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Moon Guard's real AoE builder: 'Smashes up to 8 enemies for Arcane damage (scaling with block value + max mana), reduces attack speed; consuming a star reduces cooldown.'

nodes.name: Nebula
nodes.description: Blocking applies Scattered Stars to the attacker.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as this spec's real Scattered-Star-off-tanking mechanic: 'Blocking applies Scattered Stars to the attacker.'

nodes.name: Chosen of the Moon
nodes.description: Learn Chosen of the Moon, reducing your physical damage taken and taunting nearby enemies.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Reduces physical damage taken + AoE taunt.' Real named strength - flat physical reduction plus a real AoE taunt in one button.

nodes.name: Blanket of Stars
nodes.description: Increases block chance and block value.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as core mitigation: 'shield-gated block burst,' referenced repeatedly as this spec's primary defensive layer.

nodes.name: Moonlit Bulwark
nodes.description: Learn Moonlit Bulwark, shielding for an amount equal to your maximum mana. Usable while stunned.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Shields for an amount equal to max mana. Usable while stunned.' Analogous to Ardent Defender/Guardian of Ancient Kings per the handoff's retail comparison.

nodes.name: Astral Reconstitution
nodes.description: Converts a percentage of damage taken into mana.

nodes.name: Guarded by the Moon
nodes.description: Consuming a Scattered Star increases your block chance for a duration, stacking.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 20 Passive. Consuming a Scattered Star boosts block chance (stacking).'

nodes.name: Vengeance of Elune
nodes.description: Learn Vengeance of Elune, an unavoidable AoE Arcane hit that scales with Attack Power and Intellect, usable only after parrying.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'AoE Arcane damage (scales with AP + Intellect), unavoidable; only after parrying.' Real parry-punish payoff button.

nodes.name: Asteroid Belt
nodes.description: Periodically grants the Asteroid Belt buff, increasing hit rating and expertise.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 20 Passive. Periodically grants Asteroid Belt buff; boosts hit rating (from Int) + expertise.' Handoff doc calls this a built-in duty cycle rather than a flat stance.

nodes.name: Celestial Impact
nodes.description: Learn Celestial Impact, a ground stomp dealing Arcane AoE damage and stunning nearby enemies.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Ground stomp: Arcane AoE + stun.' Moon Guard's capstone AoE control tool.

nodes.name: Starlight Duelist
nodes.description: Blocking or parrying increases your damage dealt for a duration.

nodes.name: Shrouded Stars
nodes.description: Grants the party and raid a damage reduction buff. Does not stack with similar effects.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Party/raid damage reduction (no stacking with similar).'

nodes.name: Dancing in the Moonlight
nodes.description: Parrying refunds Energy and strikes back at the attacker.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'parrying refunds Energy + hits back (Dancing in the Moonlight).'

nodes.name: Star Pupil
nodes.description: Damaging critical strikes grant a stack of Star Pupil, increasing your critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Second Moon
nodes.description: Every 10th Scattered Star consumed launches a comet, dealing Arcane damage.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as a real burst payoff: 'Every 10th Scattered Star consumed launches a comet.' Called out in the rotation writeup: 'the spender IS your burst too.'

nodes.name: Starbound
nodes.description: Increases healing done and received by 3%, doubled while below 20% health.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts healing done + received, doubled below 20% health.' Called out as one of Moon Guard's only real heal-facing tools alongside Touch of Moonlight.
